name: Vraska, Soul of Stone
description: An Echoverse gorgon raised under the guilds of Ravnica who can animate statues, remains unguilded, and is a valuable ally to the Theorist though not a replacement for his Vraska.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
